PURPOSE: Deterministically enumerate one complete snapshot-bound finding universe with fully typed root components and deterministic disposition of external basename matches.

SNAPSHOT_BINDING.RULE: Every repository path/blob consumed by one manifest MUST resolve from the same control_commit_sha/control_tree_sha. No working-tree, latest-HEAD, or mixed-snapshot lookup is permitted.

PATH_NORMALIZATION.ORDER: ascending UTF-8 bytes of normalized path

PRIMARY_RULES.INFRA_RULE: A primary-root blob is NON_FINDING_INFRA only when basename exactly matches INFRA_BASENAMES. Other primary-root blobs must parse as a finding definition or become PARSE_ERROR/UNSUPPORTED_CANDIDATE.

DISPOSITION_RULES: Every tracked blob outside PRIMARY_ROOT whose basename matches BASENAME_REGEX emits exactly one external_sweep_candidate_row.
For .json candidates, parse strict JSON. Syntax failure => PARSE_ERROR.
For .md candidates, parse only the leading metadata region using RAW_EXTRACTION.MARKDOWN. Invalid duplicate metadata keys or malformed FINDING_ID => PARSE_ERROR.
If a supported candidate parses successfully and has no FINDING_ID field/key at all, disposition=NON_FINDING_MATCH. NON_FINDING_MATCH is accounted but does not itself block completeness.
If FINDING_ID exists but is null, empty, non-string, not already NFC, or has leading/trailing Unicode whitespace, disposition=PARSE_ERROR.
If a valid FINDING_ID exists, basename stem before extension MUST equal FINDING_ID exactly; mismatch => LOCATOR_CONFLICT.
A valid matching external definition => FINDING_DEFINITION_EXTERNAL and contributes one normalized_finding_row.
If the same FINDING_ID resolves to distinct definition paths anywhere in primary or external definitions, every involved identity is DUPLICATE_FINDING_ID_CONFLICT and completeness fails.
A path identified by an explicit external locator must resolve to the same FINDING_ID and blob at the pinned snapshot; mismatch => LOCATOR_CONFLICT.

JSON.TYPE_RAW: exact top-level /TYPE or null when absent
JSON.SEVERITY_RAW: exact top-level /SEVERITY or null when absent
JSON.STATUS_RAW: exact top-level /STATUS or null when absent
JSON.RULE: No alias, recursive search, coercion, case folding, trimming, or inferred value.

MARKDOWN.REGION: bytes from file start through the line immediately before the first blank line; if no blank line, entire file
MARKDOWN.DUPLICATE_KEY_RULE: Any duplicate metadata key in REGION => PARSE_ERROR
MARKDOWN.FINDING_ID: exact FINDING_ID metadata key or ABSENT
MARKDOWN.TYPE_RAW: TYPE value or null when absent
MARKDOWN.SEVERITY_RAW: SEVERITY value or null when absent
MARKDOWN.STATUS_RAW: STATUS value or null when absent
MARKDOWN.VALUE_RULE: Captured values are preserved exactly except the grammar's syntactic separator spaces; no semantic trimming/case folding/inference.

AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_POINTER_REGISTRY.ARRAY_WILDCARD: * means each array element in numeric index order
AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_POINTER_REGISTRY.REFERENCE_VALUE_RULE: Referenced finding ID must be a non-empty NFC string with no leading/trailing Unicode whitespace.

EXTERNAL_LOCATOR.RULE: Locator file blob SHA is bound into the manifest root. A locator is resolution evidence only and never supplies or overrides severity, status, type, or finding semantics.

TYPES.conflict_code_or_null: non-empty NFC error code string or null

primary_source_accounting_row.NULL_RULE: finding_id_or_null is null unless a valid ID was parsed; conflict_code_or_null is null iff the row has no row-level conflict.

TYPES.conflict_code_or_null: non-empty NFC error code string or null

external_sweep_candidate_row.NULL_RULE: NON_FINDING_MATCH has finding_id_or_null=null and conflict_code_or_null=null. Blocking dispositions require conflict_code_or_null non-null.

TYPES.json_pointer: exact registered JSON pointer string after array-index expansion
TYPES.definition_blob_sha_or_null: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA or null

authority_reference_row.NULL_RULE: definition path/blob are non-null iff resolution_status=RESOLVED_EXACT.

TYPES.FINDING_ID: valid non-empty NFC string without leading/trailing Unicode whitespace
TYPES.TYPE_RAW: JSON string or null, preserved exactly
TYPES.SEVERITY_RAW: JSON string or null, preserved exactly
TYPES.STATUS_RAW: JSON string or null, preserved exactly
TYPES.AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_PATHS: array of unique normalized authority_path#json_pointer strings sorted by UTF-8 bytes

normalized_finding_row.CONFLICT_RULE: RAW_FIELD_CONFLICT=true if duplicate/contradictory authoritative raw fields are observed for the same definition. Such a row blocks completeness.

TYPES.detail_hash: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of UTF8(NFC(canonical diagnostic statement))

TYPES.errors: array of validation_error_row sorted by code,path_or_null,finding_id_or_null,detail_hash UTF-8/null-first

validation_summary.DERIVATION: complete=true iff blocking_error_count=0, duplicate_finding_id_count=0, unresolved_authority_reference_count=0, all tracked primary blobs are accounted exactly once, all external regex matches are accounted exactly once, and every authority pointer is evaluated.

ORDERING.AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_ROWS: authority_path UTF-8 bytes, then json_pointer UTF-8 bytes, then finding_id UTF-8 bytes
ORDERING.NORMALIZED_FINDING_ROWS: FINDING_ID UTF-8 bytes, then DEFINITION_PATH UTF-8 bytes
ORDERING.VALIDATION_ERRORS: code,path_or_null,finding_id_or_null,detail_hash using UTF-8 byte order and null before string

FIELD_TYPES.contract_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA of this exact contract
FIELD_TYPES.external_locator_blob_sha: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA of EXTERNAL_LOCATOR.PATH at pinned snapshot

COMPLETENESS_REQUIRES: primary root fully accounted exactly once
external sweep completed and accounted exactly once on the same pinned tree
every authority-referenced finding resolves exactly once
root hash recomputes exactly from the typed root object
PROJECTION_BINDING: Any CONTROL_P0 projection must bind this manifest root hash, this contract blob SHA, and the same control_commit_sha/control_tree_sha.
Universe layer performs no control-vs-product classification and no terminal-status interpretation.
